tools.name: ping
tools.description: Send a heartbeat for a named check — call this once per run of your job/agent. If the named check doesn't exist yet it is created automatically (zero setup), so you can just ping the same name every run. Attach an optional one-line `note` (e.g. what the run did) that shows on the public status page.

tools.name: list_checks
tools.description: List all your checks with their current status (up/late/down/pending), last-seen time, ping count, and public status URL.

tools.name: get_check
tools.description: Get one check's current status plus its recent ping history (timestamps and notes).

tools.name: delete_check
tools.description: Delete a check and its history, by name or id.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "{key}" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_checks · Public sink: ping · Destructive: ping, delete_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_checks · Public sink: ping · Destructive: ping, delete_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
